title: Lotus Alchemist
description: A red-haired woman in a purple robe stands behind an ornate counter filled with potion bottles, open wooden boxes of glowing green orbs, scrolls, and scattered red petals. She holds a small glowing lotus flower while a massive luminous purple lotus with a green glowing core floats behind her, beneath a framed portrait of herself hanging on an arched wall with colorful lanterns.
prompt: A beautiful red-haired woman wearing a purple and blue traditional robe stands at an alchemy counter filled with glowing potion vials, open treasure boxes containing green luminous orbs, scrolls and red petals. She holds a small glowing lotus. Behind her floats a giant translucent purple lotus flower with a bright green glowing core. A framed portrait of the same woman hangs above. Colorful red and green paper lanterns illuminate the mystical shop. Magical atmosphere, detailed digital fantasy art.
